definition: Arabic written in Latin letters with digits standing in for Arabic-specific sounds (3 = ع, 7 = ح, 2 = ء): "3amel eh".
details: Arabic written in Latin letters with digits standing in for Arabic-specific sounds (3 = ع, 7 = ح, 2 = ء): "3amel eh". Common in chat and social data; systems either normalize it via transliteration or must be trained to understand it natively.
